workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it

the single-column lecture's H1 sets span: 'page' only so that its page-anchored soot field and candle paint above the top of the text block: without it the opener's design is clipped at the column's top edge, although a span means nothing in one column

a heading style's layout.columnRule is never drawn: the canvas (and the PDF) renderer reads only doc.config.layout.columnRule, so the notes' rule is declared on the document's layout, which draws it only on pages with two columns (gotcha section-column-rule); move it into the notes style when fixed
the notes are set ragged so no line stretches the en space after a note number, and ragged text is never hyphenated: columns of about 40 characters keep the rag shallow
a no-break space is a break opportunity in design text too (design/layout.ts splits on /\s+/), so the opener's subtitle is 86 mm wide, which breaks it after a dash, never before one
design slots do not read the palette: col() writes every colour's hex beside its paletteId (gotcha palette-skips-designs)

the opener sets no minHeight: its soot field, a page-anchored box reaching below the heading, sets the reserve (gotcha opener-reserves-anchored), and the H1's default 9 pt bottom margin rides on it; if page-anchored elements stop counting, give the opener minHeight: mm(FIELD - TOP)
